pr_title: ADR 0123: close Behavior Tree visual validation
pr_body:
## Summary

- reuse the real schema-driven Behavior Tree node catalog renderer in a deterministic visual-validation fixture
- show the full catalog and a live search-filter preview together with the Play-mode Behavior Tree debugger
- include an explicit Failure transition alongside Running, Success, abort/reset reason, elapsed state, runner identity, and generation fields
- keep runtime semantics, persisted Graph/GraphView formats, stable IDs, and normal Editor behavior unchanged

## Validation

Run repository-selected Windows Validation and Editor Visual Validation. The visual artifact must be reviewed directly for the palette, categories/search, stateful decorators, runtime path/status, identity/generation fields, and layout/clipping.
